vera/presenza-digitale-studio.title: Prepare the firm’s website with Vera
vera/presenza-digitale-studio.goal: Learn to start from firm information, obtain a working website and review it before choosing publication.
vera/presenza-digitale-studio.scenario: Studio Arco has no website. We build a page introducing the firm, its supplied activities and contact path, using only the fictional profile.
vera/presenza-digitale-studio.scope: First informational website for an Italian practice. The demonstration produces a local version for review; later publication needs a destination and approvals for the exact site.
vera/presenza-digitale-studio.inputs: Open vera-studio-en.md with the audience, activities, contact and hours. Select it for the lesson and choose a teaching folder. A logo or photographs are not required; missing facts stay missing.
vera/presenza-digitale-studio.request: Vera, prepare Studio Arco’s first website from this information: introduction, activities and contact on one page readable on desktop and phone. Show a local version for review.
steps: The working chat records the selected material and prepares the project. Vera summarises the facts to use and proposes content order, typography and colours; the voice chat links these choices to the visitor’s questions.
The workflow implements HTML and styles and checks files and links. Open the working site and move through introduction, activities and contact, checking how the source information became copy.
Review the page at desktop and phone widths with its captured images. Check identity and claims, readability and links. Vera shows validation status and what remains before real publication.
deliverables: Working local website and editable files: the result to open and review.
Source and design summary, technical checks, desktop and phone captures and review status.
vera/presenza-digitale-studio.review: Compare activities, contact and hours with the profile. There should be no invented qualifications, results or contact details. The firm owns professional review; a checked local site is not an already published site.
checkpoints: Before building, name the visitor and where they should find the contact.
At review, open the contact section on the phone layout and check hours and readability.
vera/presenza-digitale-studio.practice: Use vera-update-en.md to add Friday hours in a new version while retaining the earlier information. Reopen both layouts and verify that the addition does not replace the other hours.
vera/presenza-digitale-studio.success: You can supply material, request the site, find the working version and check a change. You know that external preview and final publication are later choices bound to approved files.
vera/presenza-digitale-studio.repeat: For your practice, identify an existing or first website, public-use materials and objective. After review choose the destination; the workflow packages and publishes only the exact authorized version.
